text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the 4th corner!
With the roar of the crowd thundering, they enter the straightaway!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure, I will win!!!
Haaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Take this...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Gimme a break—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (SEIYAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac pulls ahead!!
Racing toward legend!!
Lucky Lilac takes the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Lala...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Lucky Lilac crosses the line!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A new Triple Tiara Umamusume is born!!
It's Lucky Lilac!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
She did it--!! The first Triple Tiara Umamusume
since Gentildonna!!!
Congratulations, Lucky Lilac--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That race was absolutely incredible……!
Lucky Lilac and Almond Eye,
I can't wait to see what comes next……!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
And thus, she too achieved
the glory of the Triple Tiara, but—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Is it pointless, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: No. There's no need.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: That fellow showed me results.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: That is enough.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Miss Lala.
Thank you for showing me something so wonderful—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa... gh...
Ha... wheeze...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(No good... I've hit my limit...
My whole body's on the verge of breaking down... but—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (How's that... Didja see that...?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (It's my win...!! I'm the Triple Tiara winner...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I am... the Queen...!!!
Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I lost... I lost...!!
I didn't win a single thing...!!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...A total defeat.
But... not yet...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: âLala!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...No way—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Lala.
Your running today was truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
As intensely frustrated as I feel,
I was shivering just as hard with excitement...!
My heart is still pounding even now...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That is why I will definitely challenge you again!!
Until I defeat you, the strongest queen!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Why are your eyes
sparkling like that...ya?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Can't ya even think that just a little bit?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ("You can't beat Lala," huh...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Today, I definitely surpassed my own limits. It really was the best run I could've given.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (It was such a satisfying race that no one could blame them for thinking it was my peak. ...And yet—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(You're already planning to surpass it.
You're convinced that you can.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Where's all that confidence coming from...?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...? Lala?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Almond Eye-san, thanks for today.
I reckon it's about time for me to head out.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I've got people waiting on me, too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right!
I'm so sorry for keeping you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Alright, see you at the next race!
I'll be looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you're right.
...See ya.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Switch gears.
Now is not the time to be feeling like this...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Right now is the time to celebrate with all our might together...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)
choice_data_list: Luck...! You bloomed in full glory...!
Luck...! You bloomed in full glory...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...This is the flower you helped bloom.
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Truly... thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The sight Lucky Lilac showed me today, her heroic figure—
I will remember it for the rest of my life and carry it with pride."
choice_data_list: Thank you for letting me be your partner.
Thank you for allowing me to be your partner.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Now, shall we hold our heads high before everyone?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That we make the best duo ever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Lucky Lilac claimed the glory of the Triple Tiara,
becoming a historic Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
S-So you're really running
in the Japan Cup for your next race, then!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The victory I couldn't achieve
in the Triple Tiara,
I will definitely seize it here!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: The Senior Class members who have declared their entry are an exceptionally prestigious and formidable lineup. What are your thoughts on this?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "It was precisely with that feeling in mind that I decided to enter the race."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I will win the Japan Cup against an amazing field and prove that I am the strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh...!!)

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "‘This announcement from Almond Eye quickly spread among race fans, pushing anticipation for the Japan Cup to its absolute peak—’"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: What should we do about the "Japan Cup"?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list: I was thinking I wanted to race with Almond Eye

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The matchless rival I fought alongside
all throughout the Triple Tiara.
That is Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a rival like that running in the Japan Cup,
Lucky Lilac must have mixed feelings about it. However—
choice_data_list: If you want to run, it'll require some tough conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Lucky Lilac was
far more exhausted from the recent 'Shuka Sho'
than we had imagined."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering a grueling race like the Japan Cup,
where so many powerhouses gather,
means risks are unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, what matters most
is how Lucky Lilac feels."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If she wishes to run, then as her Trainer, it's my duty to give my absolute all to make that wish come true.
choice_data_list: Could you share your thoughts with me?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I think I will pass on it.
The Japan Cup, that is.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Just as you said, Trainer, I still have lingering fatigue from the Shuka Sho, and on top of that—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
…………There will be more chances
for me to run with Ai-san
in the future, after all.
choice_data_list: Okay, then let's pick a different goal race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As of right now, a prime candidate for our target race is the Nakayama Kinen—a 1800m turf GII held at Nakayama Racecourse next February.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's a traditional race where Senior Class Umamusume often run to test their mettle with an eye on the big races from spring onwards.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"The Nakayama Kinen, huh?
...Sounds good. By that time, everything should be fully back in top shape."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's aim for the Nakayama Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, it was decided to kick off the Senior Class
with the Nakayama Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (This is no good...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(When I decided not to run in the Japan Cup today...
Back then, I...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I felt relieved.
...Relieved that I didn't have to race against Ai-san.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That is sooo lame~~~~............

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Is this... how a Triple Tiara queen really thinks?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I should just hold my head high.
I should just think that I'm the stronger one.
When I'm the one who's winning—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Why... can't I do it—
